theirReference: Cristian is wonderful and very experienced host. After arriving his place, he showed central part of Bogota and taught me about life and history of Bogota. He always took care of me and gave a lot of advices. This is my first time at South America, but I felt very safe thanks to his advices. His family also welcomed and accepted me warmly, pets are very cute. His place is in very good location, easy access to central part of Bogota and look how local people life. I love the terrace, always very good view and good place to drink Coffee. If someone look for host in Bogota, I will recommend Cristian. He help you and makes your travel more fun. Muchs gracias, Cristian!!
myReference: Hosting Yohei was a very pleasant experience ✨. He is a kind, respectful, and thoughtful person, making the time we shared really enjoyable. He brought me a variety of chocolates with different flavors, which was a very sweet and appreciated gesture 🤍. We visited the Botero Museum together, and I also helped him with directions on how to get to Monserrate. Throughout his stay, he was organized, clean, and very considerate, always respecting the house rules. I would gladly host him again and highly recommend him to other hosts. theirReference: Cristian reached out to me through my public trip to Bogotá here on Couchsurfer, and when I saw all his great references, I opted to stay with him and his family for some nights. And I'm so glad I did! First of all he was very flexible and easy going leading up to my stay, regarding when I'd arrive and my plans for the stay. He had all the information on the area and how to get to the place ready, and was fast to answer any inquri I might have. He welcomed me with a huge smile and genuine interest. On my second day there, he took me on a little private tour of Candelaria, and showed me around the area. We talked about future travel plans and our respective countries and cultures. Cristian is easy to talk to, and really such a swertheart. The accommodation is as described, and the view from the top room is just breath taking. Kitchen and bathroom could use a little cleaning, but I also think it should be up to us couchsurfers to keep it well maintained. I loved that the cats came to keep me company at night, as I miss my own when I'm travelling. Cristian, thank you so much for letting me stay there, and for showing me around. I enjoyed talking with you. Have fun on your next adventure, and may the couchsurfing community be as generous to you as you are with us.
myReference: Ida was a wonderful guest. myReference: Chelsie is a very pleasant, respectful, and easygoing person with a great attitude. She’s friendly, easy to talk to, and brings such a positive vibe. theirReference: Christian home is located in BOGOTA center further south, hill up colorful neighborhood.
